# kits/arcoforte: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

Arcoforte: a 1:1 procedural sea-cliff arcology inspired by Paolo Soleri's Arcoforte (300 m peak height, 576 m span, 576,644 m2 gross floor, ~19,291 peak / ~6,945 refurbished centerpiece capacity; PLAN.md): synthesizes all three Soleri cross-section/plan/elevation plates into one complex (multilevel boat-lift harbour platform, NW marina & cliff ramp, sub-cliff fishing works & sealed automated industry vaults, 7 H-plan sea-cliff skyscrapers & 300 m Sky-Crown with cantilevered heliport, fluted Domed Rotunda, 9 battered neocliff dwelling bastions, vaulted City Center with 13 oculus skylights & 6 mushroom-pier belvederes, sheltered Central Park & waterways, Southern Linear City); 12 cutaway interior zones across living, work, and recreation (8,002 furnished catalog pieces, 6 live culture sockets, ARCOFORTE.HULL concrete-face curves, opts.noTerrain PRNG isolation). Verified: build.py, tests/test-arcoforte.js, verify.py --assert. Read README.md, API.md

Docs: `API.md`, `AREAS.md`, `BLUEPRINT.md`, `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `PLAN.md`, `PORT.md`, `README.md`
